title: 輸電避雷器與絕緣協調
titleEn: Transmission surge arresters and insulation coordination
summary: 以避雷器能量、保護距離與絕緣裕度串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect arrester energy, protective distance and insulation margins through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

stages.title: 波與絕緣
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「波與絕緣」的模型及判讀，共六項獨立保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units develop waves and insulation through six separately saved modeling and interpretation tasks.

steps.title: 過電壓種類：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「過電壓種類」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for overvoltage types.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「過電壓種類」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。雷擊、開關與暫時過電壓有不同時間尺度。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「依持續時間分類測試波形。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for overvoltage types, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Lightning, switching and temporary overvoltages differ in duration. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Classify waveforms by duration. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 依持續時間分類測試波形。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「過電壓種類」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping overvoltage types verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「過電壓種類」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「依持續時間分類測試波形。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for overvoltage types; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 雷擊、開關與暫時過電壓有不同時間尺度。
knowledge.textEn: Lightning, switching and temporary overvoltages differ in duration.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 依持續時間分類測試波形。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Classify waveforms by duration. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 教學矩形脈波假設電流 5 kA、避雷器電壓 100 kV、持續 20 μs，能量 W=∫vi dt=10 kJ。真實波形須積分且多次衝擊需熱恢復模型，不能由此挑選額定。
knowledge.textEn: For an illustrative rectangular 5 kA pulse at 100 kV lasting 20 μs, W=∫vi dt=10 kJ. Real waveforms need integration and repeated surges need thermal recovery; this does not select a rating.

quiz.question: 審查「過電壓種類」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for overvoltage types?
options: 雷擊、開關與暫時過電壓有不同時間尺度。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「過電壓種類」的驗證。
只調整「過電壓種類」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Lightning, switching and temporary overvoltages differ in duration.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping overvoltage types verification.
Tuning the displayed overvoltage types result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 雷擊、開關與暫時過電壓有不同時間尺度。 依持續時間分類測試波形。
quiz.explanationEn: Lightning, switching and temporary overvoltages differ in duration. Classify waveforms by duration.

steps.title: 過電壓種類：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「過電壓種類」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for overvoltage types.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。依持續時間分類測試波形。 比較差異是否符合「雷擊、開關與暫時過電壓有不同時間尺度。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Classify waveforms by duration. Compare the result against: Lightning, switching and temporary overvoltages differ in duration. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 依持續時間分類測試波形。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「過電壓種類」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping overvoltage types verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「過電壓種類」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for overvoltage types; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.
